description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterFilter class, which provides functionality to unregister filters in the Smarty templating engine. It extends from Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterFilter and implements the unregisterFilter method.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterFilter
classes.description: A class extending Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterFilter that handles unregistering filters within Smarty templates.

methods.name: unregisterFilter
methods.description: Method to unregister a specific filter by type and callback in Smarty templates.
